description: Sends a test payload (flagged as a test) to the webhook to verify availability, signature handling and receiver behavior. On delivery failure returns 502 with details (`reason`, `webhook_status`) — handy for debugging integrations.

confirm.description: Set to true to authorize this write/destructive call even if STATUSER_ALLOW_WRITE is not enabled in the server config. Required for one-off overrides.

name: webhook_test
title: Send test request to webhook
